text:
Sam: Heads-up: noticed 14 leads in the last hour with owner=unassigned after enrichment. SDRs flagged poor context in Slack.
Lina: Were those from the new webinar signup form or general landing pages?
Sam: Mostly webinar. Form posts to HubSpot -> enrichment webhook -> RR. The webhook times out sometimes and HubSpot clears enrichment props, which trips our claim filter.
Noah: Short-term fix idea: add a lightweight `rr_hold` flag for 20s so the router skips recently-enriched-but-unconfirmed leads. Low blast and easy to toggle.
Priya: Agreed. Also we should avoid sending incomplete records to Salesforce until enrichment_status==complete. Add mapping rule to block partial pushes.
Sam: Pseudo-change:
```
# router decision
if enrichment_status == 'complete' or now() - enrichment_updated_at > 20s:
    eligible_for_rr = true
else:
    eligible_for_rr = false
```
Noah: I'll implement router flag and logging `rr.skip=hold` behind feature flag. Canary to 2% traffic (APAC).
Lina: Ops note: SDRs need a saved view `hs:rr_hold` to triage quickly. Priya can you update playbook wording.
Priya: On it. I'll also add a short blurb for SF team to ignore leads with `enrichment_status != complete`.
ops-bot: ALERT 1798881300 - router detected 14 leads with enrichment_timeout > 30s, action=hold
Sam: Action list: Noah deploys flag (ETA 90m), Priya updates playbook + SF mapping (ETA EOD), Lina creates SDR view (ETA 2h). We'll monitor `marketing.rr.missed` and `sdr.manual_backfills`.
Noah: Rolling flag now to APAC 2%. Will post progress here.
Sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
